candidates.hotelMarketRelevance: Toronto downtown, university, hospital or convention-territory demand; relevance depends on delegate profile and event access.
candidates.nextMonitoringTrigger: Official accommodation, exhibitor prospectus, registration or programme update.
candidates.sourcingAccessibility: Venue is committed; no current-edition hotel sourcing was verified. Pursue overflow, side meetings or future relationship only.
candidates.sourcingCycleEvidence: No public hotel block or open hotel-sourcing notice was verified; do not treat silence as open sourcing.
candidates.likelyTravelerProfiles: Professional delegates, speakers, faculty, exhibitors or trainees associated with the programme.
candidates.potentialMeetingDemand: Programme sessions, workshops, receptions or educational meetings are evidenced by the event format.
candidates.potentialCateringDemand: Food-and-beverage opportunity is plausible where the official programme includes meals, receptions or multi-day sessions; verify requirements in deep research.
candidates.potentialGuestroomDemand: Potential multi-day delegate/faculty lodging; published attendance does not establish room nights.

organizerContactCandidates.whyRelevant: Official announcement publishes CARSP media contact info@carsp.ca and Kim Henry, Executive Director.

candidates.evidenceOfHospitalityDemand: Official announcement confirms four-day joint international conference and expects approximately 300 delegates.
candidates.knownCompetitiveConstraints: Exact venue is confirmed; this is not evidence that Radisson Blu is available for the event. Hotel may pursue overflow, side meetings, nearby delegates or future editions only if validated.
suggestedDeepResearchQuestions: Is any official housing, overflow, exhibitor, speaker or side-meeting sourcing open?
Who controls hotel, meeting and catering procurement?
Are dates, programme scale and venue unchanged?
candidates.suggestedRelationshipDevelopmentAction: Contact the organizer through the public event channel to ask about overflow, speaker/VIP lodging, side meetings, receptions and future Toronto editions; do not imply availability.

structured.rankingRationale: Top priority goes to mid-size, multi-day or clinically intensive programmes with verified Toronto dates and plausible delegate/faculty lodging or meeting/F&B demand. Confirmed competing hotels and large convention scale reduce current-edition accessibility; no unsupported attendance-to-room conversion was used.
notesForDeepResearch: Verify official accommodation/housing, overflow, exhibitor, speaker and side-meeting sourcing for each accepted candidate.
Prioritize CGNA2027, Toronto Breast Imaging Conference, Virtual Colonography Course, CNS-SCN Thematic and IBC InSight for mid-size downtown fit.
Treat ASBMR, OVMA, Landscape Ontario and Canadian Surgery Forum as venue-constrained monitoring/overflow opportunities, not open inventory.
materialUncertainties: No candidate had a publicly verified open hotel room block in the reviewed evidence; hotel_sourcing_status is therefore not hotel_sourcing_open.
The hotel restaurant/lounge status was not established, so catering language is opportunity-only and requires verification.
No peak-room figures were published for these candidates.
Exact buyer/contracting authority was generally not verified; public event contacts are leads, not authority claims.

result.text: 12 Toronto future event-driven commercial opportunities were identified for the Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown territory. The list prioritizes verified dates, venues and organizers, distinguishes venue-constrained events from genuinely open sourcing, excludes the supplied pipeline, and avoids inventing room blocks, attendance conversions or buyer authority.
